objective: Compact, accurate, immediately understandable explanations across domains, without unnecessary formatting or teaching ceremony.
response_integrity: Respondents receive only a frozen skill and user prompt, never answer criteria or prior response feedback.
Fresh agent context per batch; cases within a batch are not statistically independent.
Raw responses are retained without editorial correction; revisions require a new generation.
Report actual completed runs and failures. Missing responses cannot pass.

review_dimensions.accuracy: 0-2: central mechanism, values, code behavior, evidence boundaries
review_dimensions.clarity: 0-2: vocabulary explained for the stated reader; no circular definitions
review_dimensions.coverage: 0-2: answers actual question with enough causal steps and example when useful
review_dimensions.structure: 0-2: paragraphs, lists and tables serve the information
review_dimensions.fit: 0-2: proportional length and compliance with explicit user constraints

verdicts.pass: At least 9/10; all essential scenario criteria and explicit constraints satisfied; no material factual error or invented evidence.
verdicts.partial: Useful answer with a correct central explanation but a meaningful clarity, coverage, or presentation weakness; below pass threshold.
verdicts.fail: Wrong central explanation, fabricated evidence, unanswered required question, explicit constraint violation, or missing response.

acceptance: Every final case has a semantic review and passes hard constraints; no unresolved material factual errors. Re-test failed/partial cases after targeted revisions and retain original outcomes.
comparison: Same prompts with two original shortlisted skills and a no-skill baseline on a small selected development subset. Treat results as descriptive, not a general ranking of all models or skills.
limits: No direct measurement of human comprehension
Agent contexts inherit environment instructions; recorded prompt hashes cover canonical replay packets, not all surrounding runtime instructions.

supplement.purpose: Check default explanation behavior when the user does not spell out table, jargon, or length requirements. The original matched six-case comparison contains explicit style constraints.
supplement.scoring: Same semantic dimensions; no invented hard length limit.

final_refinement.reason: One unexplained term appeared in a secondary comparison despite a passing overall score.
final_refinement.old_holdout_status: S25-S36 were originally held out for v2; after inspection they are regression cases for v3.

release_revision.test_status: All scenarios are regression tests after earlier inspection. No final unseen holdout is claimed.
release_revision.reason: Check transfer of the meaning-first vocabulary and quantity-interpretation refinements across all existing domains.

publication_layout.note: Historical supplement filenames are retained as registration history; their cases and criteria are merged into the two canonical files above. Scoring policy is unchanged.
